channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jalen Williams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jalen Williams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Evan Turner on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Jalen Williams
item.description:
Turner continued to say of James.

“You look at the starting five. I don’t see him slowing down. Who’s better? I mean, who’s better? It’s almost like the Stefon Diggs thing. If I’m not the better one, who’s a better number two than me that’s just elite? I think Jalen Williams from OKC is one of the best top 15 players in the world, and I would throw ‘Bron up against him any night. Jalen Williams is elite. LeBron has got five or 10 more years the same way with Kevin Durant. They’re like, ‘Where am I going?’ There’s nothing else to do. This shit is easy.”

Evan Turner on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Jalen Williams, Oct 15, 2026. Source: rotogrinders.com.

item.title: Sam Presti on Jalen Williams
item.description:
Sam Presti on Jalen Williams' injury concerns:

“We feel like we've found every possible advantage of this area. What we're hopeful of is that he really just needed a full offseason to get back. He looks fantastic and great.”

Sam Presti on Jalen Williams, Sep 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chandler Parsons on Victor Wembanyama, Jalen Williams, Ajay Mitchell, Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Chandler Parsons on Chet Holmgren:

“I do think there is some sort of mental block when it comes to Victor Wembanyama. I really do. I don't think it is like Space Jam, but I don't think he can take two shots in Game 7. You don't play 33 minutes and take two shots. I would rather live and die with going down with Ajay Mitchell out and Jalen Williams out. I would rather have him be 0 for 15 than one for two.”

Chandler Parsons on Victor Wembanyama, Jalen Williams, Ajay Mitchell, Chet Holmgren, Jun 2, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Jalen Williams
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:SGA on not having Jalen Williams:

“Not having Dub for the whole year basically sucked. He's such a unicorn out there. He's a 20 point per game scorer, guards 1-5.Last season he got All NBA for offense, All NBA for defense and was an All Star. At 24 years old. Losing a guy like that hurts. Having a swiss army knife like that.. is a luxury.. and we didn't have that luxury this year.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Jalen Williams, May 31, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams:

“He’s been hellbent on trying to get himself to this point. I give him credit. He’s a big team guy, big competitor. He’s obviously not 100%. He didn’t know what to expect, I didn’t know what to expect. So it was a matter of getting him out there in an insulated role and see what he could bring to the team. … He hasn’t done a full return to play the way that he would.”

Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams, May 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Ajay Mitchell on Jalen Williams
item.description:
Ajay Mitchell on Jalen Williams returning:

“It’s amazing to have him back. We need him. We’re really happy he’s back. Excited to get back to playing with him.”

Ajay Mitchell on Jalen Williams, Mar 27, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams’ hamstring strains helping him feel better about his wrist:

“Objectively, during that period of time, he was taking more shots with the wrist in practice than he had at any other point in the season… He had a look of confidence that was really exciting to see… It’s better than it’s ever been since the surgery. It’s the best it’s been right now. It’ll only continue to improve.”

Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams, Feb 19, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Jalen Williams
item.description:
SGA on Jalen Williams playing through a torn ligament:

“Dub is a warrior. He just did whatever it took.. He's a competitor. He has heart. And when that kicks in, it takes over.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Jalen Williams, Sep 29, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Sam Presti on Jalen Williams
item.description:
Sam Presti on Jalen Williams:

“He deserves an enormous amount of credit for his approach. He's a pretty grounded guy. And that comes from the people around him. You can trust him. I think he knows what it's about.”

Sam Presti on Jalen Williams, Jun 30, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Jalen Williams
item.description:
2025 NBA Finals MVPShai Gilgeous-Alexander:

“Jalen Williams is a once-in-a-lifetime player. Without him, his performances, big-time moments, shot-making, defending, and everything he brings to this team, we don’t win this championship. This is just as much my MVP as it is his.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Jalen Williams, Jun 22, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Jalen Williams
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Chet Holmgren on Jalen Williams:

“He’s one of those guys you want to see succeed. Especially when you know him personally. He treats everyone well. He’s always respectful. We gotta make sure he gets his credit, gets his flowers.”

Chet Holmgren on Jalen Williams, Jun 17, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Ja Morant on Pascal Siakam, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jalen Williams
item.description:
“Instead of focusing on the performances we seen from Jdub/Shai [Jalen Williams and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander], Tj/Siakam [T.J. McConnell and Pascal Siakam], how this series is going,”

Ja Morant on Pascal Siakam, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jalen Williams, Jun 17, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Dylan Harper on Jalen Williams, Anthony Black, Cooper Flagg
item.description:
A pro scout told HoopsHype about Dylan Harper:

“He could end up being better than Flagg. He’s not the most athletic, but he has that ‘slow-fast’ pace to his game. Offensively, I think Harper has a higher ceiling than Flagg. Worst case, as a lead guard, he’d be like [Anthony] Black – but Harper moves better and scores at a much higher level. His ceiling feels Jalen Williams-esque – a versatile player who can function as a guard or has the size to be a point-wing, it really depends on how a team develops him. Harper is a better shot creator than Flagg and makes everyone around him better. He moves like a wing but plays like a guard.”

Dylan Harper on Jalen Williams, Anthony Black, Cooper Flagg, Jan 22, 2025. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Jalen Williams
item.description:
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander:

“Nobody has his prints on our winning more than Jalen Williams. And that’s why he deserves to be an All Star.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Jalen Williams, Jan 16, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Jalen Williams
item.description:
SGA on Jalen Williams’ All Star case:

“You don’t have this record because of 1 All Star…He averages 20 on hyper efficiency and we are 1st in the West.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Jalen Williams, Jan 13, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams:

“He’s established himself as a great player.. a high impact player.. And he’s got the humility, the confidence and the drive to keep on improving. He’s only in his third year. He’s not a finished product.. I have great admiration for his willingness to do that. It shows he wants to be great. He sees the big picture.”

Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams, Dec 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Mark Daigneault:

“Here's a stat: Jalen Williams and I both shot the same amount of free throws tonight. We both shot zero,and all I did was call a couple time outs, called some plays, and clapped a couple times when we scored and he was in the throat of the defense for 48 minutes.”

Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams, Dec 19, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Sam Presti on Jalen Williams
item.description:
Sam Presti on Jalen Williams:

“The thing I love most about Dub is he's not a numbers guy. What makes him different to me is the motor.. He's driven.. I think he's going to come back a better player. He's comin'.. he's comin'.”

Sam Presti on Jalen Williams, May 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Kenrich Williams on Jalen Williams
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Kenrich Williams on his prediction last year of Jalen Williams being an All-Star:

“I'm thinking about being a GM in the future. He was a complete player coming out of college. I've seen it the first time we played pickup together.”

Kenrich Williams on Jalen Williams, May 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort, Jalen Williams
item.description:
“The fact that we have (Jalen Williams) and (Lugentz) Dort who can take the point-of-attack guys, it allows him to use his great help anticipation. He’s got great hands, great length and he really smells the ball at this point. So he deserves credit as an individual defender. But (Williams and Dort) get credit for his ability to get the steals because a lot of that’s coming off the ball.”

Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort, Jalen Williams, Jan 25, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams:

“He was great. We don’t win the game without him. But it’s the same I see every night…He’s a really good player.”

Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams, Jan 2, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Stephen Jackson on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace
item.description:
Stephen Jackson asked Chet Holmgren,

“[Shai Gilgeous-Alexander], Cason Wallace, Lu Dort, [Josh] Giddey, Jalen Williams, how do you feel about next year?”

Stephen Jackson on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace, Aug 2, 2023. Source: Thunderous Intentions.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Josh Giddey, Jalen Williams
item.description:
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on playing with Josh Giddey and Jalen Williams:

“I think the three of us are all getting better for sure. The three of us are a big part of the future here.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Josh Giddey, Jalen Williams, Mar 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Josh Giddey, Jalen Williams
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on the Thunder having 3 All-Star representatives in himself, Josh Giddey & Jalen Williams:

“Having three guys here is pretty good for our future. It means we’re heading in the right direction.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Josh Giddey, Jalen Williams, Feb 18, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Tre Mann on Jalen Williams
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Tre Mann on Jalen Williams:

“JDub’s been great. Everybody’s pretty much seen it after Summer League. We expected that from him. He’s a great player. Sam (Presti) picked him for a reason and he’s showing it.”

Tre Mann on Jalen Williams, Dec 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.
